Why JuneGiri

Family-run. Forest-rooted.
Worth the drive.

Six reasons our guests come back year after year, and bring their parents and kids the next time.

Family-built, since 2020

Same family. Same recipes. Same welcome at the gate. Not a chain.

Edge of Rajaji

Real wilderness, not a view of it. Leopards, barking deer, porcupines, 300+ bird species.

One-stop, end-to-end

Stay, yatra, treks and activities, coordinated by the same team. Zero handoffs.

Garhwali kitchen

Farm-to-table Garhwali meals. Spring water. Recipes from Geeta's family.

Edge of Rajaji forest

Wake to birdsong and forest trails, not traffic. Direct access to the wild.

WhatsApp-first

Real conversations, not forms. We reply within an hour.

Sustainability

Light footprint, deep roots.

We're an eco-stay, and we mean it. Built with local stone, solar-heated water, and zero plastic on premises.

  • 100% solar-heated water across all rooms
  • Rainwater harvesting for kitchen & garden
  • Zero single-use plastic, refillable steel bottles
  • Compost & organic farm on-site
  • Local stone & reclaimed wood construction
  • We hire from the villages around us wherever we can
Family & Kids

Built for the way Indian families travel.

Parents, grandparents, toddlers, we plan for everyone. Tell us who is coming and we will sort the room, the food and the pace.

  • Kid-safe forest trails & pet-friendly grounds
  • Adjoining family rooms (sleeps 4-6)
  • Children under 5 stay free, no extra bed
  • Simple, mild food for children on request
